author: Engineezy
description:
Building an RC Soccer Table
•••
It was supposed to be a simple and fun project.  I just wanted an arena to play RC soccer with my friends.  But then I got the idea of automatically tracking goals.  I tried a simple sensor, but when a car accidentally drove into the net it would trigger, which led to needing a camera system to track the ball.  I had no idea how to make this happen, so I dove into the new @ChatGPT app, which not only helped me to select the right hardware for the job, but also was able to write the code needed to make a fully functioning scoreboard and coordinate it with the inputs from the camera modules.  
•••
I am a mechanical engineer first, but I have more hardware and coding experience than most.  Even with that, getting a system like this to work would've required more time, effort and attention than I would be willing to give because this was a fun personal project that could've easily existed without an electronic scoreboard.
